# ARM64 objects against llvm-mc, the only reference here that writes them.
=== branches
        .text
        bl      foo
        b       foo
        b.eq    foo
        cbz     x0, foo
        cbnz    w1, foo
        tbz     x2, #3, foo
        tbnz    w3, #0, foo
=== adr and adrp
        .text
        adr     x0, foo
        adrp    x1, foo
        adrp    x2, foo+0x1234
        adrp    x3, foo-8
=== lo12 fields
        .text
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:foo
        add     x1, x1, :lo12:foo+0x1234
        ldr     x2, [x0, :lo12:foo]
        ldr     w3, [x0, :lo12:foo+8]
        ldrb    w4, [x0, :lo12:foo+3]
        ldrh    w5, [x0, :lo12:foo+6]
        str     x6, [x0, :lo12:foo+16]
        ldr     q0, [x0, :lo12:foo+32]
        ldr     d1, [x0, :lo12:foo+16]
=== data
        .data
        .quad   foo
        .quad   foo+9
        .long   foo
        .long   foo+5
        .rva    foo
        .rva    foo+7
        .secrel32 foo
        .secidx foo
        .long   foo@IMGREL
        .long   foo - .
        .long   foo + 3 - .
=== local and global targets
        .text
        .globl  f
f:      nop
        bl      f
        b       local
        adr     x3, f
        adrp    x0, f
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:f
local:  ret
        .data
        .quad   f, local
        .rva    local
=== cross-section
        .text
        .globl  code
code:
        adrp    x0, thing
        ldr     x0, [x0, :lo12:thing]
        adrp    x1, stuff+8
        add     x1, x1, :lo12:stuff+8
        bl      code
        ret
        .data
thing:  .quad   code
        .section .rdata,"dr"
stuff:  .long   thing - stuff
        .quad   0, code
=== hello
        .text
        .globl  main
main:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov     x29, sp
        adrp    x0, msg
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:msg
        bl      puts
        mov     w0, #0
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret
        .section .rdata,"dr"
msg:    .asciz  "Hello from rsasm!"
=== sections and alignment
        .section .mycode,"xr"
        ret
        .section .mydata,"dw"
        .byte   1
        .balign 8
        .quad   2
        .bss
        .space  16
=== weak and comdat
        .text
        .globl  first
first:  ret
        .weak   w
w:      ret
        bl      w
        .section .text$c,"xr",discard,c
        .globl  c
c:      ret
=== function call kept for the linker
        .text
        .def    f; .scl 2; .type 32; .endef
        .globl  f
f:      ret
        bl      f
